---
name: research-basic
description: Build a source-grounded research note from selected local papers, with explicit locators and uncertainty.
---

1. Identify the selected source files and record their names.
2. Read only the selected files. For PDF/DOCX use the Research Stack document tool and preserve its page/paragraph locators.
3. Separate source-backed findings from synthesis, interpretation, and open questions.
4. Attach a locator to every material factual claim. Do not infer a citation from search snippets.
5. Save a new Markdown note under `notes/`; do not overwrite existing files or alter source documents.
6. State extraction gaps (scanned pages, tables, equations, malformed/encrypted files) and whether any external model received the content.
